games.summary: The Week 5 tie gets its rematch on a short week, and the cleanest number in it is third down: Washington sits near the bottom of the league at staying on the field, and Daniels has slipped below average over the last three games. New York's offense has looked crisper with McCarthy than the full-season Giants numbers say, and the Commanders' pass defense has been below average all year. The two things that keep this tight are McCarthy's hip and a Giants line that gives up sacks at one of the league's higher rates. If McCarthy moves normally, New York owns the better offense by a little more than a field goal's worth; if he's limited or Winston has to come in, this is a coin flip.
